title: Why Does Your Phone Die in the Cold?
short_title: Why Your Phone Dies at 20% in the Cold
description: Your phone says 20% and then dies in the cold, then comes back to life when it warms up. Here is the simple science of what slows down inside a lithium battery.
tags: why phone battery dies in cold
comment: Has your phone ever died on you in the cold? Tell me your story!

scenes.text: Why does your phone say twenty percent, then suddenly die the moment you step out into the cold?
Inside your battery, tiny charged particles called ions swim from one side to the other. Their journey makes the electricity.
In the cold, the liquid inside gets thick and sluggish, like syrup. The ions move slowly, so the battery cannot deliver power fast enough.
The phone sees the power drop and shuts down, even though energy is still stored inside.
Warm it up and the ions speed back up. So keep your phone in an inside pocket, close to your body.
